## About me

Hello, I’m Ava Conforti, currently pursuing a Bachelor of Arts in Information Science with a certificate in Digital Studies at the University of Wisconsin–Madison. I love exploring what technology can do and how it can make a meaningful impact. My curiosity keeps me learning and growing, both personally and professionally.

I’m drawn to hands-on roles in information technology, problem solving, and troubleshooting. I’m eager to deepen my technical knowledge and contribute to meaningful projects while learning from experienced professionals.

Fun fact

Running helps me manage stress and enjoy life more. Outside of class and work, you’ll find me reading or crocheting.
